[NADP.4.3.1] Neither cooldown nor supersede-on-correlation is the adapter's.
The engine suppresses a call inside its cooldown window before the call
reaches the adapter ([LCRS.8.2]), so an adapter keeps no cooldown map; an
adapter's own argument-dedup LRU, if it has one, is a safety net and nothing
more. The engine retracts the prior response fact and `CallError` before the
call reaches the adapter ([LCRS.6.2.1]), and the adapter must not retract
them itself.
